verdict.rationale: Runpod's REST API and GraphQL API provide programmatic access to manage Pods, Serverless endpoints, templates, network volumes, and registries, mirroring most console/UI functions, and CLI/SDKs further extend this parity. However, some UI-only conveniences (e.g., billing/auto-pay setup, one-click template browsing, security/compliance dashboards) aren't clearly exposed via API, and the execution environment is described by users as 'locked down,' limiting some low-level flexibility. missing for 10: independent verification that 100% of UI actions (billing, plan/discount management, compliance settings) are API-exposed, and confirmation that the locked-down environment doesn't block certain API-driven operations.
